[i][u][b]The Results of the Oceanic Republic's[/b][/u]

GDP:$1.268 trillion
GDP Per Capita:$38,305
Populations:33.1 million

The Oceanic Republic's GDP has increased to $268.6 billion. This is due to strong growth in financial services, including central banks, financing global trade, and successful initial public offerings on a new stock exchange in Berlinwerk, the country's capital city. This has solidified the country's status as an emerging financial center.

The manufacture and export of high-value products, including fashion, jewelry, and high-value goods, have grown extensively as more investment is being made in these fields. This growth through exports has raised the country's trade balance and strengthened it in the global market.

AI-powered online shopping services and logistics platforms have received a lot of investment, making trade and retail more efficient. As more people access online services, the digital economy has grown by a large amount by adding $102.1 billion to the GDP.

And, the financial sector has grown to $120.2 billion, with luxury goods exports up to $46.3 billion. These sectors reflect the Republic's policy to diversify the economy and rely less on traditional industries. The Oceanic Republic is experiencing high GDP growth of 26.86% in recent months. This has resulted from equitable trade policies, directed production plans, and favorable new ideas in key sectors.

[u][b]Population Growth and Effects on Jobs[/b][/u]

The population has grown to 33.1 million, rising by 700,000 owing to additional births and immigration from other countries. People move into the Republic because its industries are growing and it has many job opportunities. Sectors that have many jobs include advanced manufacturing, digital services, and logistics.

This population growth has worked to the advantage of the employment sector by releasing a continuous stream of skilled labor into growing industries. The Oceanic Government's emphasis on employment training programs and labor force development has been central to ensuring a stable economy and continuing growth.
[/i]

[b]Expansão imperial[/b]
Embora o império esteja poderoso e crescendo cada dia mais e mais, é inegável que a expansão de nossas terras é mais que necessário, recursos tais como petróleo estão em nossas fronteiras do norte, essenciais para manter uma força militar forte, além de manter nossa própria soberania a crescente influência de outras nações como Gendarme no hemisfério sul de Erene, a expansão da nação é algo essencial em momentos como os de hoje, e isso é um fato inegável.
Não só focaremos na expansão, o Imperador D. João IV, mais a assembléia investiram no aumento do treinamento e financiamento às forças armadas, o treinamento de soldados não só aumentará, como números, e no geral a capacidade bélica do império.
[b]Expansão à Iporã[/b].
Ao noroeste do Império, Iporã é um território que tem muitos recursos de interesse, como cobre, petróleo e gás natural, serem encontrados em terras indígenas ou não, esses recursos são vitais para Bravanor, assim como ocorreu em Minas D'ouro, só precisaremos reduzir suas terras a porções menores e pobres.
.
.
.
Passando pelo rio que separa a nação, o Rio Guaíra, com algumas dezenas de milhares soldados liderados pelo Comandante Fernando Lopes, equipados com os Fuzis IMBEL típicos do exército imperial mais alguns IFVs e APCs, o império não viu a necessidade do uso de mbts, mas principalmente artilharias ASTROS foram utilizadas, cidades foram destruídas, sem muita resistência se renderam já que as cidades na região estavam pouco preparadas para bombardeios tão repentinos.
Ao cruzar o rio , os soldados foram surpreendidos por uma emboscada, locais armados com algumas espingardas, facões e rifles de precisão atacaram, os soldados tinham capacetes e coletes bonspara 60 anos atrás, seus coletes não protegiam dos fuzis IMBEL, algo que chocou até os oficiais que não imaginavam um exército tãoobsoleto, seus armamentos anti blindagem mal podiam penetrar armadura, e os únicos 3 IFVs , tamanduá, que foram destruídos foram, 2 por minas terrestres e 1 por um de seus mísseis que atingiram em um ponto bem específico do casco traseiro.
[I] snipers em árvores, chão falso, mas as cidades são vazias, eles já se renderam tão rápido ao exército Bravanoriano, estão apenas desacelerando o inevitável.e isso é irritante.[/i]
O Diretor da Inteligência Bravanoriana disse quando questionado sobre a guerra em Iporã, mas ainda não deixou de rir quando viu um vídeo de uma invasão de soldados em uma pequena cidade do pequeno país.
.
.
.
[I] RENDAM-SE AGORA E SEJAM POUPADOS DE UM MASSACRE, TODOS SEUS SOLDADOS E OFICIAIS FORAM DERROTADOS, RENDAM-SE E SEJAM POUPADOS [/I]
o comandante Fernando Lopes falou por um megafone enquanto montado em um Tamanduá, um grupo de milicianos jovens saíram de um prédio atirando com espingardas e explosivos amarrados  em seus corpos, pareciam estar querendo dar a vida para destruírem alguns blindados, mas as MT 05 montadas nós Tamanduá os eliminaram , confuso o Comandante disse.
[i] eles, uh,tentaram nos atacar com uma espingarda de caça?[/i]
Um dos coronéis, José Álvares disse confuso ao ver esse avanço inesperado, mas logo sob ordem do general Lopes, avançou junto do restante do exército, a capital da nação, São Miguel mal resistiu, assim como seu povo, e rapidamente o presidente, Solano Aguirre declarou rendição....não que ele tivesse muita escolha.
[b]Atermatch[/b]
petróleo passará a ser extraído, gás natural, tudo que Iporã poder nos oferecer sera extraído, além disso, ferrovias ligando o estado com o resto do país também serão feitas.

[spoiler=translation has 601 words]
Imperial Expansion
Although the empire is powerful and growing more and more each day, it is undeniable that the expansion of our lands is more than necessary. Resources such as oil are on our northern borders, essential to maintain a strong military force, in addition to maintaining our own sovereignty and the growing influence of other nations such as the Gendarme in the southern hemisphere of Erene. The expansion of the nation is something essential in times like today, and this is an undeniable fact.
We will not only focus on expansion, Emperor D. João IV, and the assembly invested in increasing training and funding for the armed forces. The training of soldiers will not only increase, but also the numbers, and in general the military capacity of the empire.
Expansion to Iporã.
To the northwest of the Empire, Iporã is a territory that has many resources of interest, such as copper, oil and natural gas, whether found on indigenous lands or not, these resources are vital to Bravanor, just as happened in Minas D'ouro, we will only need to reduce their lands to smaller and poorer portions.
.
.
.
Passing through the river that separates the nation, the Guaíra River, with a few tens of thousands of soldiers led by Commander Fernando Lopes, equipped with the IMBEL Rifles typical of the imperial army plus some IFVs and APCs, the empire did not see the need to use MBTs, but mainly ASTROS artillery was used, cities were destroyed, without much resistance they surrendered since the cities in the region were little prepared for such sudden bombings. When crossing the river, the soldiers were surprised by an ambush, locals armed with some shotguns, machetes and sniper rifles attacked, the soldiers had good helmets and vests... for 60 years ago, their vests did not protect against IMBEL rifles, something that shocked even the officers who could not imagine an army so... obsolete, their anti-armor weapons could barely penetrate armor, and the only 3 IFVs, anteater, that were destroyed were, 2 by landmines and 1 by one of their missiles that hit a very specific point on the rear hull.

snipers in trees, false ground, but the cities are empty, they have already surrendered so quickly to the Bravanorian army, they are just slowing down the inevitable... and that is annoying.

The Director of Bravanorian Intelligence said when asked about the war in Iporã, but he still couldn't stop laughing when he saw a video of a soldier invasion in a small town in the small country.

.
.
.
SURRENDER NOW AND BE SPARED FROM A MASSACRE, ALL YOUR SOLDIERS AND OFFICERS HAVE BEEN DEFEATED, SURRENDER AND BE SPARED
Commander Fernando Lopes spoke through a megaphone while riding an Anteater, a group of young militiamen came out of a building shooting with shotguns and explosives strapped to their bodies, they seemed to be willing to give their lives to destroy some armored vehicles, but the MT 05s mounted on the Anteater eliminated them, the Commander said confused.
they, uh, tried to attack us with a hunting shotgun? One of the colonels, José Álvares, said he was confused when he saw this unexpected advance, but soon, under orders from General Lopes, he advanced along with the rest of the army. The nation's capital, São Miguel, barely resisted, as did its people, and the president, Solano Aguirre, quickly declared surrender... not that he had much of a choice.

Atermatch
oil will be extracted, natural gas, everything that Iporã can offer us will be extracted, in addition, railroads connecting the state with the rest of the country will also be built.
[/spoiler]

[b]The Eastern Strait[/b]
[b]1:34pm HST+7[/b]

The Battle of the eastern strait has been raging on for hours at this point. The Sal-Baliz were putting up a tough fight, despite  the rusty buckets that they fight in. The tide was beginning to turn in their favour due to the sheer amount of explosives they had. One of the Balizian ships had even gotten close enough to send a boarding party over, however this stroke of luck for the Sal-Baliz would not last long. At around 1:34pm, the distinct sound of bobian fighter jets could be heard overhead. The Hydronian troops watched in awe as a blessing came down from the sky, bobian missiles. Air-to-surface missiles came raining down upon the Balizian war ships, disabling over half of them in one strike. This gave the Hydronians the perfect opportunity to renew their naval offensive. The Hydronian guns and torpedoes opened fire further disabling another quarter of the Sal-Baliz's confused armada. Even more great news came when a fleet of Italy-dutchian warships approached from behind, surrounding the Sal-Baliz. As the THEP forces moved in closer and closer, the Sal-Baliz would never surrender and by the end, all of their warships had been sunk, no survivors. The Hydronians would rather have taken prisoners of war, but they put up too tough of a fight.

By 2:00pm, rescue and repair ships had arrived at the sight of the battle to bring the injured home. The 7th, 8th, 9th and 11th fleets also began the journey back to tursan 5 base, but the 12th  and 13th fleets were ordered to remain. This incident has brought the security  of the eastern strait to light and as a result, many predict the Hydronian government will try to seize the various islands scattered throughout the strait. The battle may be won, but not yet the war. [b][i]The Invasion awaits...[/i][/b]
